passages.heading: Risk factors
passages.text: This section contains forward-looking statements that are subject to the Cautionary Statement appearing on page 2 of this annual report. Risks to Sony are also discussed elsewhere in this annual report. Sony must overcome increasingly intense competition, which could lead to lower revenue or operating margins. Sony has several business segments in different industries with many product and service categories, which cause it to compete with many existing and new competitors ranging from large multinational companies to highly specialized entities that focus on only one or a few businesses and also, potentially, with outsourced manufacturing service partners that currently supply products to Sony. These competitors may have greater financial, technical, labor and marketing resources available to them than those available to Sony. Sony’s financial condition and operating results depend on its ability to efficiently anticipate and respond to these established and new competitors. The competitive factors Sony faces vary depending on the nature of the business. For example, in the Game & Network Services (“G&NS”), Music and Pictures segments, Sony competes for talent, such as game creators, artists, songwriters, actors, directors and producers, and for entertainment content that is created, acquired, licensed and/or distributed. Competition for talent and appealing content can lead to lower profitability if the higher costs required for such talent and content acquisition cannot be recouped through greater sales. In addition, the evolution of innovative technologies such as artificial intelligence (“AI”) and the use of them by competitors may impact Sony’s existing business models. In the G&NS, Music and Pictures segments, operating results can be impacted by worldwide consumer acceptance of their products, which is difficult to predict, and by alternative forms of entertainment and leisure activities available to consumers, as well as by competing products released or sold at or near the same time. In the G&NS, Entertainment, Technology & Services (“ET&S”) and Imaging & Sensing Solutions (“I&SS”) segments, Sony competes on the basis of various factors including price and function, and price competition can lead to lower margins when costs cannot be reduced at a proportional rate. Even for those products where Sony believes it has a strong competitive advantage, such as image sensors, it is possible that its competitors’ technological capabilities will accelerate such that Sony would be unable to maintain its advantageous market position. Additionally, in terms of consumer electronics products, to produce products that appeal to changing and increasingly diverse consumer preferences, including constantly changing consumer interest in minimizing energy consumption and selecting materials with environmental considerations in mind for both products and packaging, or to overcome the fact that a relatively high percentage of consumers already possess similar products, Sony must develop superior technology, anticipate consumer tastes, and rapidly develop attractive and differentiated products with competitive prices and features. credit_strengths.text: Sony's balance sheet carries net cash, with unrestricted cash exceeding interest-bearing borrowings, so leverage is not a binding constraint. Gross leverage sits well below the sector median and improved year on year, consistent with a minimal indicative financial risk profile.

Operating cash flow covers dividends and buybacks several times over, so shareholder returns are funded from internally generated cash rather than incremental borrowing. Cash generation also rose sharply across the trend period, strengthening the buffer against cyclical swings in entertainment and image sensor demand.

key_risks.text: Competition for talent, content and image sensor technology is intensifying, and rivals may hold greater financial and technical resources. Management warns that higher content and talent costs may not be recouped through sales, and that AI-driven business model shifts could erode the group's advantageous market position in sensors.

The debt note shows short-term borrowings as the largest single funding component, with a weighted average rate above that of the unsecured bonds, and long-dated loans extending well beyond the medium term. Refinancing therefore depends on continued access to bank and commercial paper markets at acceptable pricing.

debt_servicing_capacity.text: Interest coverage is strong in absolute terms and comfortably above the sector median, and it improved year on year as operating income grew. EBITDA-based coverage is likewise far above the sector median, indicating ample capacity to absorb higher funding costs on the short-term borrowings.

Operating cash flow relative to debt is well above the sector median and improved sharply year on year, so debt service does not rely on asset sales. Free cash flow and its coverage of debt cannot be assessed because capital expenditure is not disclosed on a consistent basis.

overall_credit_view.text: The credit profile is anchored by net cash, high interest coverage and strong cash conversion, placing leverage and coverage well inside sector norms. Operating margin, however, trails the sector median despite improving year on year, reflecting the lower-margin hardware and gaming mix relative to peers.

Our forward view is that leverage stays modest while cash generation funds distributions and acquisitions, though the current ratio below one and below the sector median leaves limited short-term liquidity headroom. We would monitor content cost inflation and refinancing of short-term borrowings as the main sensitivities.

credit_strengths.text: 索尼的資產負債表持有淨現金，未受限現金超過計息借款，因此槓桿並非約束性因素。總槓桿遠低於行業中位數，並按年改善，與最低限度的指示性財務風險狀況一致。
經營現金流覆蓋股息和回購數倍，因此股東回報由內部產生的現金而非增量借款提供資金。現金產生在整個趨勢期內亦大幅上升，加強了抵禦娛樂和影像感測器需求週期性波動的緩衝。

key_risks.text: 人才、內容和影像感測器技術的競爭正在加劇，競爭對手可能擁有更大的財務和技術資源。管理層警告，較高的內容和人才成本可能無法透過銷售收回，而人工智能驅動的商業模式轉變可能侵蝕集團在感測器方面的有利市場地位。
債務附註顯示短期借款是最大的單一融資組成部分，其加權平均利率高於無抵押債券，而長期貸款延伸至遠超中期。因此，再融資取決於能否繼續以可接受的定價進入銀行和商業票據市場。

debt_servicing_capacity.text: 利息覆蓋率絕對值強勁，並舒適地高於行業中位數，且隨著營業收入增長按年改善。基於EBITDA的覆蓋率同樣遠高於行業中位數，表明有充足能力吸收短期借款的較高融資成本。
經營現金流相對債務遠高於行業中位數，並按年大幅改善，因此償債不依賴資產出售。自由現金流及其對債務的覆蓋無法評估，因為資本支出未按一致基準披露。

overall_credit_view.text: 信貸狀況以淨現金、高利息覆蓋率和強勁的現金轉換為錨，使槓桿和覆蓋率遠處於行業規範之內。然而，營業利潤率儘管按年改善，仍落後於行業中位數，反映相對於同業利潤率較低的硬件和遊戲業務組合。
我們的前瞻觀點是，槓桿保持溫和，而現金產生為分派和收購提供資金，儘管流動比率低於一且低於行業中位數，留下有限的短期流動性緩衝。我們將監測內容成本通脹和短期借款的再融資作為主要敏感因素。
